newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police raid $4.5 mln hijack warehouse.
newsitem.headline: S.African police raid $4.5 mln hijack warehouse.

text.p: South African police said on Wednesday they had smashed a truck hijacking syndicate operating in central Johannesburg and seized stolen consumer goods valued at 20 million rand ($4.5 million).
Goods stolen in at least five truck hijackings were found in a warehouse in Johannesburg's inner city Newtown area which was raided by the recently established police Truck Hijacking Unit.
The most recent attack was on May 31 when a 49-year-old truck driver transporting soap from the port of Durban to Johannesburg was hijacked, police said in a statement.
His body was later found in the abandoned truck. The lost load had been offloaded at the Newtown warehouse.
Gauteng province, centred on Johannesburg, is the worst affected region for hijackings -- accounting for around two-thirds of the 16,554 truck and car-jackings reported last year.
